Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is primarily an AP-MS (FLAG IP) to identify protein complexes. While it focuses on phosphorylation (mod_phospho), there is no evidence of a global phosphopeptide enrichment step (like TiO2/IMAC); rather, phosphorylation was searched as a variable modification on the AP-eluted peptides. Therefore, mod_ap_ms is the primary routing signal, with mod_phospho as a secondary PTM search requirement.
